findings.finding: Port check is a denylist, not an allowlist; any other loopback port is trusted.

raising=False hides renames; assert-is-None is trivial; edge hosts/values untested.

findings.finding: Only DB and Redis host/port are checked; object store, DB name/user and Redis index are not.
Skip message named DB_PORT/REDIS_PORT but the settings use EIMS_DB_PORT/EIMS_REDIS_PORT.
